# Show me the evidence: what changed in v1.1.0

From v1.0.0 (2026-11-16, `1dfdcd515`) to v1.1.0 (2026-11-16, `9b1f8f2dc`), paragraph by paragraph.

0 paragraphs added, 0 removed, 1 changed in place, 74 unchanged. About 2 words added and 0 removed. Insertions are marked like this, deletions like this; unchanged runs are folded to one line; figures appear as their file names.

[all versions](../show-me-the-evidence.md) · [v1.2.0 →](v1.2.0.md)

66 unchanged paragraphs, under In short {#in-short}, Why now {#why}, Seven pages that prove {#site}…

1. **The site template.** Seven pages and the machine files, from one content file per person: profile, proofs, case studies, posts, hobbies, manual, pack. Static, fast, accessible, perfecteasy to read on a phone, deployable on GitHub Pages, and fork-ready ([fork it](../../fork-it.md)). 2. **Eight themes, then many more.** The eight personas as forkable templates, each a full site with sample content clearly marked. Then a theme per job family: nurse, teacher, lawyer, chef, data scientist, sales, architect, researcher. 3. **The look-back interview** as the front door: voice or text, one question at a time, each dot marked remembered or evidenced ([connect your dots backwards](../../connect-your-dots-backwards.md)). 4. **The evidence-hunter:** finds and checks the person's public work, and asks before it uses anything about a former employer. 5. **"Make it yours":** a designer agent that interviews the person about their tastes and proposes three directions, never the same three twice. 6. **Pages for you:** a tailor agent that reads an employer's public material and drafts the note, the thing made for them and a 90-day plan; unlisted, expiring, anonymised when public; and a version for a meeting, not only an application. 7. **QA as a gate:** facts against evidence, links, privacy, LinkedIn match, accessibility, phone layout, no hidden text, no invented facts. A failed check blocks publishing. 8. **The recruiter pack and the recruiter's cell:** a one-screen pack on every site, and shortlist pages for recruiters, with consent, expiry and client decisions flowing back. 9. **Synthetic users** who review every template: a hiring manager with ten seconds, a recruiter on a phone, a sceptical CTO, a screen-reader user ([synthetic users for your website](../../synthetic-users-for-your-website.md)). 10. **The ladder on the cell's page:** the recipe and the fork free, then set up, coached, a team, a recruiter's cell, with the side panel from [the cell is the unit](../../the-cell-is-the-unit.md). 11. **A weekly debrief for the search:** applications, replies, what worked, what to tailor next, for the person and nobody else. 12. **A hub of examples:** every template and every real site whose owner agrees, listed on the hub ([a hub for agentic sites](../../a-hub-for-agentic-sites.md)). 13. **Ourselves first:** sites for me and for team members who want one, each reviewed by its owner before it goes live.
